items.title: Dragging a token in combat shows its movement limit
items.do: On Sylwen's turn in combat (with AP remaining, without clicking Advance first), click-and-drag Sylwen across the map; cancel the drag (right-click or Esc), then drag 2 squares and drop, then drag again.
items.expect: Starting a drag immediately shows Sylwen's Speed movement-range outline on the map (just like clicking Advance); cancelling clears the outline; dropping 2 squares spends 1 AP and keeps the remaining 4-square range outline visible around the new square until End movement or 0 squares left.

items.title: Undo movement (Ctrl+Z & Undo move button) refunds 2d12 + Foundry ruler
items.do: On Sylwen's turn in combat, drag 2 squares (spends 1 AP, 4 sq left), drag 2 more squares (2 sq left), then press Ctrl+Z twice (or use the "Undo move" button in the Situational tab). Also try clicking Advance first, dragging, and pressing Ctrl+Z; and verify Ctrl+Z still works normally out of combat or on the Walls layer.
items.expect: First Ctrl+Z steps Sylwen back to after the first drag (4 sq left, range redrawn, Foundry's drag ruler drops back by 2 sq); second Ctrl+Z returns Sylwen to her start square, refunds the 1 AP, closes the Advance banner, removes the movement from Turn Breakdown & Encounter Log, and resets Foundry's movement history to 0. Ctrl+Z out of combat or on Walls still runs Foundry's normal undo.

items.title: Line of Effect lines (Option B: dark-cased emerald/crimson dashed + blocked X)
items.do: Select Sylwen, target Ogre Chieftain across a wall/corner, and toggle Line of Effect (Shift+L or 2d12 Tools drawer) on both light and dark map backgrounds.
items.expect: Clear corner lines are high-contrast emerald green dashed with dark casing; blocked corner lines are crimson red dashed with dark casing and a white X inside each blocked corner dot; center line has dark casing (cream when clear, bright orange when a creature is in the way).

items.title: Large token visibility tuned (no wall-sliver leak, still visible when peeking)
items.do: Place Ogre Chieftain (2×2) behind a horizontal wall ending near its bottom-middle (like your v0.0.495 screenshot with only a tiny sliver of light under its bottom edge), then move Sylwen right so ≥25% of one of the Ogre's 1×1 squares peeks cleanly into view.
items.expect: Ogre Chieftain stays hidden when only a razor-thin sliver of light passes its bottom wall edge, and becomes cleanly visible as soon as at least a quarter of one of its occupied squares peeks out past the wall.
